canonical_format.name: M64 Matter-64
canonical_format.purpose: Fixed 64-byte records for geodetic point/spectral anchors, holographic entity parameters, strata/fluid columns and phase-juncture parameters. These declared data meanings are not proof of qualified biology or physics.

layout.header: 64 bytes, repr(C, align(64)), Pod: magic[4], version u32, header_size u64, total_file_size u64, spatial_origin f32[2], elevation_datum f32[2], chunk_table_offset u64, chunk_count u64, header_crc32c u32, container_flags u32.
layout.header_crc: CRC-32C of header bytes 0..56, excluding checksum and flags.
layout.directory: 64-byte aligned entry: chunk_uuid[16], spatial_hilbert_index u64, byte_offset u64, byte_length u32, record_count u32, srid_geodetic_code u32, lut_bank_epoch_id u16, chunk_record_mode u8, compression_flags u8, bao_root_hash_prefix[12], entry_crc32c u32.

relationship_to_10d_and_hmc.m64_vs_10d: Distinct format owners/magics. M64 records carry matter/geospatial parameters; container_10d carries versioned sections for mesh, materials, fields, nodes and other tensor-manifold payloads. Shared CRC implementation is code reuse, not byte-layout equivalence.
relationship_to_10d_and_hmc.hmc: Canonical bundle owner uses QBDL magic, bundle version 1. Ecopunk producer adds .m64 as a named intact file entry alongside .10d/.q42; packaging does not convert or validate M64 semantics.
relationship_to_10d_and_hmc.ambiguous_api: StudioArtifact::export_format(10d/e64) returns application/x-qualia-10d+json, a JSON Tensor10D envelope. It is not the binary M64/E64/10D producer.

concrete_sdk_gaps_for_prioritization.gap: Promote complete checked M64 parsing to the canonical owner: checked header/directory arithmetic and bounds, count/length agreement, alignment-safe reads, mode/version/codec admission, overlapping regions, actual record validation and clear endian policy. Existing directory.validate checks CRC only; header.validate does not compare declared size/offset/count to a byte slice.
